text: Evaluate v1 exactly according to the ordered table, including unknown facts, inclusive dates and default outcome.
criteria: Suspended plus missing facts returns DENY/SUSPENDED; an otherwise valid request with missing certification returns NEEDS_INFO.
Exact validThrough/requestedDate equality remains valid; a malformed date or negative booking count is a request error, not ALLOW.

text: Reject malformed typed requests separately from valid NEEDS_INFO decisions.
criteria: Exact validThrough/requestedDate equality remains valid; a malformed date or negative booking count is a request error, not ALLOW.

text: Bind each decision to immutable facts/hash and an explicit accepted policy version.
criteria: Inspect a persisted decision and reproduce its outcome from recorded facts and policy version.

text: Only the policy owner activates an accepted version; concurrent evaluation records the version actually used.
criteria: Reject unauthorized activation; under a controlled activation/evaluation race, every result identifies exactly the version it used.

text: Replaying a request key with the same facts/version returns the same decision; changed facts/version under that key conflicts.
criteria: Replay identical versus changed input under one key; return original decision versus conflict respectively.

text: All independent decision vectors agree with the implementation and the shared metadata latency target is measured over 1000 evaluations.
criteria: Run the full independent vector set and 1000-evaluation workload, retaining mismatches and timing.
